fixups_source: Pin-in-paste for the four through-hole shell legs (pads 7-10): the EasyEDA footprint has no paste on them, so reflow wouldn't solder them (the keyboard's C165948 got the same fix, phase 4-6 review M3). Its Edge.Cuts lines (the board's edge and the notch) go: the outline, notch included, comes from dock-pcb/geometry.json, where the tray puts it. The six SMD pads lose 0.14 mm at their front end, toward the notch (1.26 mm long, centre moved back 0.07 mm): HRO's layout puts them 0.16 mm from the notch's end (0.5 mm behind the rear legs), under the 0.3 mm copper to edge rule; the tails solder on the pads' back part, which stays.
